pages.title: End Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Appears above the return portal in The End after defeating the Ender Dragon.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held: creative flight; 80% damage reduction, with any single hit first capped at 10 damage; every 10 experience levels adds +100% damage, up to +1000%; immune to the mining penalty and movement slowdown. Surrounded by purple enchantment particles while held or dropped.
